en.title: The Second Hand's Migratory Bird and the Remnants of Memories Sleeping in the Deep Sea
en.premise: As a deep-sea researcher, I was caught in a 'collapse of time' during an investigation of undersea ruins, forcing me to repeat the same day over and over. Every time I wake, I am greeted by the same bitter taste of yesterday's coffee and the same view from my window. Relying on the trajectory of a mechanical creature—a 'migratory bird' that weaves through the distortions of spacetime—I dive into the depths of the abyss to break the cycle of recurring destruction.

zh.title: 秒针的候鸟与沉睡于深海的记忆残渣
zh.premise: 作为一名深海调查员，我在调查海底遗迹时被卷入了“时间的崩塌”，陷入了不断重复同一天的轮回之中。每次醒来，迎接我的都是昨日那份咖啡的苦涩，以及昨日那扇窗外的景色。循着那如“候鸟”般穿梭于时空扭曲中的机械生物的轨迹，为了斩断这不断循环的毁灭连锁，我向着深渊的底部潜去。
